description: Future Engineers es un equipo de jóvenes apasionados por la tecnología, la ingeniería y la exploración espacial. Para el NASA Space Apps Challenge, desarrollaremos un simulador de misión de astronautas. Buscamos aplicar conocimientos de programación, robótica y diseño, mientras fortalecemos el trabajo colaborativo, la comunicación y la resolución de problemas, demostrando que los jóvenes podemos contribuir.
summary:
We created a "point & click" simulator in which, through challenges, the basic comprehension necessary to adapt to a real situation is taught. The way we approach the project's complexity dynamics is by withholding some information so that the user has to use critical reasoning to overcome these challenges.
We bring space exploration to young people in a fun, educational, and interactive way that allows them to understand the real challenges astronauts face when exploring the Moon and space.
details:
Detailed project description.


Our project consists of developing an interactive Point & Click simulator, designed to bring space exploration closer to young people over 10 years old through educational experiences based on challenges and problem-solving.


What does it do and how does it work?
The simulator presents different scenarios and challenges inspired by situations that astronauts might face during a lunar exploration mission.
Users must explore the environment, gather clues, analyze information, and make decisions to overcome each challenge. Some data is presented in a limited manner, requiring the application of critical reasoning, observation, and the ability to relate information to progress.


What benefits does it offer?
It promotes interactive learning, logical thinking, problem-solving, decision-making, and scientific curiosity. Additionally, it facilitates the understanding of the technological and human challenges involved in space exploration.

What is the expected impact?
We aim to spark the interest of new generations in science, technology, engineering, and space exploration by turning complex concepts into accessible, dynamic, and educational experiences.

 


What tools were used?
The project involves the use of digital design and software development tools to create the scenarios, interactions, challenge logic, and user experience.
• Adobe Illustrator,
• Adobe Photoshop.
• Adobe Premiere
• Canvas.
• Godot
• Claude.
• Chap GPT
• Kerbals space program, for structural concept.
• Apple Gallery.
• Pintura.
• WhatsApp.

In what sense is it creative?
His main innovation consists of transforming the learning about space exploration into a discovery experience, where it is not enough to receive information: The user must investigate, interpret, and solve situations to progress.


What factors did the team take into account?
The age of the users, the ease of navigation, the educational value, the progressive complexity of the challenges, the connection with real-life space exploration situations, and the importance of maintaining an engaging and accessible experience were considered.
